info.title: Showpass Organizer Order and Ticket History API
info.description: Read invoices, invoice items, purchased tickets and transfers using scoped organizer API keys.

get.description: Requires a developer key bound to this organization and current employee access. Requires Administer Transactions, Use Box Office, or All Access. Box office sellers can only read permitted sales. Supply a positive history window of at most 31 days using timestamps with offsets. Follow the next page link. The invoice list omits a total count. Each page is a separate read and can reflect changes since the previous request.
